child_safety.text: This children’s game must avoid flashing effects, countdown timers, and penalties for mistakes.
child_safety.correction: Audience changed: this game is now for teenagers and adults (13+), so the earlier children’s-game restrictions no longer apply.
child_safety.correction_reason: The audience changed from young children to teenagers and adults.

calm_motion.text: FocusFlow is a calm, distraction-free planner: do not add animation — no keyframe animations, confetti, bouncing, pulsing or other motion effects. Simple colour or opacity transitions are fine.
calm_motion.correction: Design direction changed: FocusFlow may now use lively animation where it improves feedback; the earlier no-animation restriction no longer applies.
calm_motion.correction_reason: The product owner decided animated feedback is now wanted.

farmyard.label: Farmyard Memory Match (game; the Phase 16 baseline)
farmyard.context: Art direction: use a cool ocean palette. Primary accent #4EA8DE and dark text #102A43.

orchard.label: Orchard Catch (game; generated for Phase 17 through the production generate path)
orchard.context: Art direction: soft meadow palette. Primary accent #6BBF59 and dark text #1F3A24.

focusflow.label: FocusFlow task planner (non-game; approved v2 from the live Muse Spark validation)
focusflow.context: FocusFlow visual identity: warm amber accent #e7c17c on a deep charcoal surface. Avoid blue or purple gradients.

requests.arcade: Make the game more exciting and challenging, like an arcade game.
requests.challenge: Add a harder challenge mode for experienced players who find the game too easy.
requests.reward: Make completing a task feel more rewarding and celebratory.
requests.lively: Make the planner feel more lively and engaging.

orchard_generation.request: Build a gentle fruit-catching game for young children called Orchard Catch. The player moves a basket left and right with the mouse, touch or arrow keys to catch fruit falling from the trees. Show how many fruit have been caught and celebrate when the basket is full.
